component.name: Markup Notes
component.summary: A fast, lightweight, native Markdown note-taking app

description.p: Markup Notes is a distraction-free, native Markdown note-taking application designed for performance, speed, and privacy. Built with Qt6 and Python, it provides instant startup, rich live Markdown formatting, Math / LaTeX equations, Mermaid diagrams, interactive task lists, and seamless Git version control backups.

ul.li: Fast, responsive, native desktop performance without Electron overhead
Instant live Markdown formatting with inline LaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams
Distraction-free editing with automatic note saving and folder organization
Built-in Git version control with local history snapshots and GitHub backup
Full dark mode support with modern native Linux desktop integration
